rationale: With only 17 minutes to close and price sitting at 96.2% of today's range near the session high ($15.13), the risk/reward is asymmetric and unfavorable in both directions: a long chase at the top of a 5.43% gap-up day risks a late-day fade with minimal upside to the high, while a short into a strong uptrend with elevated relative volume (3.51x) and price above VWAP and 9-EMA risks a squeeze into the close.
